user.title: Add a Secomat
user.description: Enter your Claim Token and an optional name. The Secomat ID will be discovered automatically from the Krüger cloud API.

reconfigure.title: Update Claim Token
reconfigure.description: Enter a new Claim Token for this Secomat. Its Secomat ID and entity history will not change.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Secomat
reauth_confirm.description: The Krüger cloud API rejected this Secomat's Claim Token. Enter a replacement Claim Token to reconnect.

error.invalid_auth: The Claim Token was rejected. Check it and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Krüger cloud API. Try again later.
error.wrong_secomat: This Claim Token belongs to a different Secomat.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Secomat ID is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Claim Token was updated successfully.
abort.reauth_successful: The Claim Token was updated and the Secomat reconnected.
